The SAP Cloud Integration API (Process Integration Runtime API) provides OData V2 and REST endpoints for deploying, monitoring, and managing integration flows, artifacts, packages, and runtime operations on SAP Integration Suite hosted on SAP Business Technology Platform. It supports message processing log retrieval, integration package lifecycle management, artifact deployment, and service endpoint discovery.
